title: PeakPVP
description: Competitive PVP Practice Minecraft Server for 1.21+
body:
**PeakPVP** is a competitive Minecraft PvP practice server for modern Minecraft versions 1.21 – 1.21.11. 

Practice a variety of popular PvP modes including:
- Sword
- Crystal
- Axe
- Mace
and more. 
 
**PeakPVP also features tournaments, events/minigames, and more.**
